label: Idea to Execution
title:
From idea to
agent-ready task.
subtitle: Capture an idea with its problem and plan. When you are ready, start work and choose who takes it. The idea keeps track of the chats and pull requests working on it.
summary: Capture an idea with a plan, start work on it when it's ready, and see where it stands from the work linked to it.
highlights: Capture a problem statement and a phased plan before an agent starts
Chats, pull requests and files that work on the idea are linked to it as agents work
Hand the idea to an agent when it is ready, choosing who works on it

details.headline: Structured idea capture
details.body: Write down the problem and sketch a plan. When you are ready, select Start work: you choose who works on it and add a note. The agent starts with the idea and can look up the chats, files and pull requests already linked to it.

screenshot.alt: Idea page for rate-limiting the payouts endpoint. The plan has a problem statement and three phases. Beside it, a status card reads In review, PR #214 is open, checks passed, with Review PR #214. Work lists two finished chats and the pull request. Related lists a research file and a related idea.
screenshot.caption: The idea keeps one current plan, with where it stands beside it

details.headline: Where it stands, at a glance
details.body: An idea's status comes from its work: In progress while an agent works on it, In review while its pull request is open, and Waiting for you when an agent asks something. Chats, pull requests and files are linked as agents work, so there is nothing to keep up to date by hand.
